name: Erina
source:
Erina is a monster girl tamer and the daughter of the famous monster girl tamer Bastal Batch. When she discovers that [url=http://vndb.org/c10474]Leo[/url] was dragged off to Squid Paradise to rescue the monster girls there from [url=http://vndb.org/c13604]Baron Squid[/url] she goes there herself with her loyal monster girl [url=http://vndb.org/c13610]Tenten[/url]. She competes with Leo for the monster girls and will capture them herself if he's too slow.

[spoiler]Late in the game she's captured by Baron Squid and held captive until she agrees to sign a contract to lose her humanity and become a monster girl.[/spoiler]
